items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you ever play with Punch before? I never played with him.

ctx.x: The lyrics. The lyrics. Yeah, we heard about them.
Several people told us about that. Kid Punch and all of them. They were playing the lyrics at that time.
Did you ever play with Punch before? I never played with him.
